question.text: The research entity must have mechanisms to ensure independence of research from:

answer.text: Other business activities that may affect research independence

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 15(2) requires the research entity to have appropriate mechanisms in place to ensure the independence of research activities from other business activities. The Trap: Independence is required from other business activities generally — not from a single department such as HR, marketing, or legal. Note: The regulation specifies the outcome (independence from other business activities); it does not prescribe the specific implementation mechanism.
